entries.topic: Administration officials in the files; Bondi's appearances

claims.text: NBC: Bondi not named in the files. Oz: Feb 2016 Valentine's invitation email to Epstein. Feinberg: Cerberus business documents 2009–18 in the files, reason unclear. RFK Jr.: flight logs and a 2012 Epstein–Maxwell email about a fossil hunt (Maxwell: c.1993–94); Kennedy says he flew in the 1990s, 'knew nothing', 'no relationship'. Lutnick: 2012 emails on island trip; acknowledged family lunch. Phelan: March 2006 flight manifest (CNN review), then at MSD Capital. Warsh: 2010 'St. Barth's Christmas' list. Barrack: friendship emails 2009–16, planned 2016 meals. Musk: 2012–13 emails. Bannon: emails/texts Jan 2018–Jun 2019, offered to 'rebuild your image'. No official accused of a crime; those who responded denied wrongdoing.

House Judiciary hearing 11 Feb 2026: survivors seated behind Bondi; Jayapal asked those who had not met DOJ to raise hands/stand and asked Bondi to turn and apologise; Bondi did not turn, said she would not 'get in the gutter' with 'theatrics', and asked why Garland was not asked; opening statement apologised to victims; Lieu said she lied under oath; Massie: Wexner redaction '40 minutes of me catching you red-handed'.
Massie said Bondi was 'afraid to' look at the survivors.

Bondi ousted April 2026; 29 May 2026 closed-door transcribed interview with House Oversight, not under oath and not videotaped (Garcia 'incredibly disappointed'); said she delegated the release to Blanche; apologised; Dhillon cited 'ground rules' on Trump questions.

Jan 2024: Judge Preska unsealed records from Giuffre v. Maxwell (2015 suit, settled 2017) after the Miami Herald's suit; ~2,000 pages unsealed 2019, more 2020–22; not a client list.

claims.text: DOJ IG (27 Jun 2023): negligence, misconduct; >75 checks missed; officers charged, prosecution deferred; no cellmate despite prior attempt; no evidence contradicting FBI's finding of no criminality; suicide.
Supreme Court declined Maxwell's appeal (6 Oct 2025), which argued the 2008 NPA's co-conspirator clause protected her.

claims.text: CBS (Dec 2025): at least 550 pages entirely blacked out; 119-page 'Grand Jury-NY' document fully redacted.
TIME (22 Dec 2025): Trump photo EFTA00000468 removed then restored 'without any alteration'.
Roll Call (30 Jan 2026): final release, over 3 million pages; ~3.5M in total of ~6M reviewed.
WSJ review (Feb 2026): 43 of 47 victims' full names left unredacted, more than two dozen minors; DOJ: takes victim protection seriously; Blanche: errors affect '.001%'.
CBS via Salon (Mar 2026): 47,635 files taken offline; DOJ says not deleted, will return after redaction.
Friedman (Mar 2026): hundreds of pages fully blacked out in the 'unredacted' set; EFTA ranges listed.
Khanna read six names on House floor; DOJ: four were lineup fillers with no connection.
Engelmayer (21 Jan 2026): no authority to supervise compliance; lawmakers can sue separately.
DOJ IG announced review of compliance, 23 Apr 2026.

Phang v. Blanche (D.D.C., Sullivan): filed 27 Apr 2026; preliminary injunction 25 Jun 2026 ordering production, foreign-language review, redaction log; motion to compel granted 16 Sep; DC Circuit denied stay 28 Oct 2026.

claims.text: ABC (2 Apr 2026): Feb 2025 Fox 'client list' on desk 'right now'; 27 Feb 2025 binders to influencers ('Phase 1', previously released); Feb 2026 hearing printout of Jayapal's search history; Democrats demanded DOJ stop tracking lawmakers' searches; DOJ said it logs all searches to protect victims; fired 2 Apr 2026, no reason given, Blanche acting.
WSJ (Jul 2025): Bondi told Trump in May 2025 his name appeared multiple times in the files; White House called story fake.
House Oversight voted to subpoena Bondi, 4 Mar 2026, five Republicans joining.
Democrats walked out of a closed-door briefing (Mar 2026), saying she would not commit to the subpoena; Bondi: 'I will follow the law'.

14 Nov 2025: Trump directed Bondi to investigate Epstein's ties to Clinton, Summers, Hoffman, JPMorgan; Bondi: 'urgency and integrity'; assigned SDNY's Jay Clayton; two days after House Democrats released emails.
